# HealthyChildren.org

> > Trusted pediatric parenting guidance and child health resources from the American Academy of Pediatrics.

HealthyChildren.org is the official parenting website of the American Academy of Pediatrics (AAP), offering evidence-based information on child development, health, safety, and family wellness. The site serves parents and caregivers with comprehensive guidance spanning prenatal care through school-age development, supported by AAP's medical expertise and editorial oversight.

## Key Topics

- Child Development
- Ages & Stages
- Parenting Guides
- Pediatric Health
- Infant Care
- Toddler Development
- Prenatal Care
- Well-Child Visits
- Developmental Milestones
- Safety & Prevention
- Family Wellness
- Health Issues
- Immunizations
- AAP Resources
- Family Media Plan

## Child Development by Age

- [Ages & Stages - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/pages/default.aspx): Comprehensive guide to child development stages from prenatal through school age
- [Prenatal - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/prenatal): AAP guide to prenatal care, pregnancy health, and birth preparation
- [Baby - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/baby): Comprehensive infant care guide covering newborn development and well-child visits
- [Toddler - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/toddler): Toddler development guide with growth milestones and parenting strategies
- [Preschool - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/ages-stages/preschool): Preschool-age child development guide covering cognitive and social skills

## Health & Wellness Guidance

- [Healthy Living - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/healthy-living/pages/default.aspx): AAP guidance on nutrition, fitness, sleep, and wellness for children
- [Health Issues - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/health-issues/pages/default.aspx): Directory of pediatric health conditions, illnesses, and medical emergencies
- [Safety & Prevention - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/safety-prevention): AAP resources on child safety, immunizations, and disease prevention

## Parenting & Family Support

- [Family Life - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/family-life/pages/default.aspx): Parenting guides on family dynamics, communication, and mental health support
- [Tips & Tools - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/tips-tools/pages/default.aspx): Collection of parenting tools including Family Media Plan and health trackers

## Core Resources

- [HealthyChildren.org - From the American Academy of Pediatrics](https://www.healthychildren.org/English/Pages/default.aspx): AAP's HealthyChildren.org homepage with parenting guides and pediatric health resources
- [HealthyChildren.org - From the American Academy of Pediatrics](https://www.healthychildren.org/English): Main entry point for AAP's HealthyChildren.org parenting and family wellness platform
- [About HealthyChildren.org - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/pages/default.aspx): Mission statement and overview of AAP's HealthyChildren.org parenting website

## News & Updates

- [News - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/News/pages/default.aspx): AAP news highlights and pediatric health updates from Pediatrics journal

## Optional

- [Medical Editor & Contributors  - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/Pages/contributors.aspx): Information about HealthyChildren.org's medical editors and editorial team
- [Sponsorship Opportunities - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/pages/sponsorship-opportunities.aspx): Corporate sponsorship and partnership opportunities for HealthyChildren.org
- [Spread the Word - HealthyChildren.org](https://www.healthychildren.org/english/our-mission/pages/spread-the-word.aspx): Social media and outreach materials for promoting HealthyChildren.org resources
